content.text: {"notes":["World coordinates are right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; therefore the car’s world-frame forward_position and forward_velocity are its x position and x velocity, in m and m/s.","The requested readout time is the absolute simulation time T = 2.0 s from initialization.","The scheduled intervention starts at 0.5283 s and remains active through 2.0 s; it applies zero-target-velocity braking at each axle with a maximum torque of 0.25 N·m.","stopped_by_T is true only if absolute forward speed is below 0.02 m/s and planar speed is below 0.03 m/s continuously for 0.2 s, with the qualifying interval ending by T."]}
